name: 88001 · Las Cruces, NM
findings: ZIP 88001 (Las Cruces) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 88001 (Las Cruces) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 88001 (Las Cruces) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 68% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 66 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 88001 (Las Cruces) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).
